title: The simplification cut is accepted
situation: Both assayers accept in their second-round verdicts; all 16 visible and 3 held-out examples pass. Two follow-up rulings, checked by the deterministic suite only: integration by a non-architect warns instead of refusing, and the supported omp version is 18.10.2. The suite fell from 11m58s to about 25s, 1,173 tests, starting neither omp nor an agent.
decision: Accepted. The only refusal of a rule left in what cratylus delivers is the record gate against rewriting the append-only record, which passes 0142's test: rewriting history is costly, has been guarded since the journal began, and the operator can get past it.
consequences: The cut is integrated into dev and installed on this host.
